title: www.VibeDuels.com a video game for Vibe Coders.
author: SimCFB
selftext:
[VibeDuels.com](http://VibeDuels.com) is a video game similar to how benchmarks work.

You take a bot with a deterministic game. There is no RNG besides the map itself. The bots are taught how to play the game. 

The game has a ranking ladder that is 100% automated. All you have to do is upload the bot.

Everything is purposely as simple as possible. We even write the initial prompt for you that you can post directly into your Claude Code or Codex or wherever. 

Completely free at the moment. No transactions whatsoever for anything. We might monetize it later but for now it's just a very soft launch.

Unlimited bots and unlimited exhibition fights (currently). 

Technically you can code the bot by hand. Nobody is stopping you. But we don't expect you to :)
